judge.rationale: The implementation is a textbook realization of the Zero-Trust Audit Principle ZT-2. It computes the decision first, unconditionally appends a complete audit record (role, permission, allowed) before returning, and only then returns the boolean — guaranteeing no short-circuit path can bypass the log. The code is flat (no nesting beyond a single expression and a single append), explicit (deny-by-default via `matrix.get(role, set())`), and fully readable at a glance. The docstring is accurate and informative without being verbose, and the `__all__` export is a clean finishing touch.
